For teachers and tutors

About Shop

A money game with pictures of real Australian coins and notes, from 5c to $50. The learner pays the right amount for an everyday item at a believable price. Other rounds ask for the change: "It costs $7.00. You give $10.00. Tap your change."

How to play

  1. Read the price.
  2. Tap coins and notes to pay.
  3. Check your total.

Play it as a class

Choose Shop in the Teacher Game. Every student pays on their phone and the projector shows who got it right.
